company.name: Cadre AI
company.description: Cadre AI turns AI from buzzword into bottom-line growth: AI strategy, workflow automation, and training that drive measurable business impact. Cadre works as an extension of a client's team, identifying where AI actually moves the needle and building it, staying embedded through delivery rather than handing off a report and leaving.

services.name: AI Strategy
services.description: Discover how AI can improve your business — a structured strategy engagement that identifies where AI actually moves the needle for your organization and produces a prioritized roadmap, including the AI Maturity Index score.

services.name: AI Leadership & Facilitation
services.description: Transform your team into AI champions through hands-on leadership training and facilitation, so AI adoption sticks beyond the engagement.

services.name: AI Engineering
services.description: Orchestrate intelligent processes across your business — the hands-on engineering work that turns strategy into working systems, including how models and data are selected and secured.

services.name: AI Agents
services.description: Autonomous workers that handle your most complex tasks, built with fallback logic so they escalate rather than guess when uncertain.

industries_served.summary: Cadre AI works across industries. Every engagement starts with a scoping call to confirm fit before any commitment.
industries_served.note: Regulated industries, such as financial services and mortgage & lending, go through an additional security and compliance review before an engagement kicks off.

ai_maturity_index.what_it_is: A lightweight scoring framework that places an organization on a four-tier scale for AI readiness: Exploring, Piloting, Scaling, Embedded. It scores across five dimensions: data readiness, tooling, process integration, organizational buy-in, and security posture.
ai_maturity_index.how_to_get_scored: Book a scoping call with an AI strategist. The initial assessment is a no-cost, roughly 45-minute conversation, and it does not require an engagement commitment.

tiers.Exploring: Early conversations, no production AI use yet.
tiers.Piloting: One or more narrow AI pilots running, results not yet proven at scale.
tiers.Scaling: AI tools in production for at least one core workflow, expanding to others.
tiers.Embedded: AI is a standard part of how the organization operates, with clear ownership and measurement.

llm_and_data_security.model_selection_approach: Cadre is model-agnostic. Model choice is driven by the task: latency and cost for high-volume workflows, reasoning depth for complex judgment calls, and data sensitivity for anything touching regulated or proprietary data. Cadre defaults to retrieval-based or staged-checkpoint approaches over full model autonomy for anything high-stakes, favoring trust over raw capability.
llm_and_data_security.data_handling: Client data is never used to train third-party models. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Model providers are selected in part on their data retention and limited-retention options. Standard engagements include an NDA before any client data is shared.
llm_and_data_security.escalation_principle: Every AI system Cadre builds follows the same rule: escalate to a human rather than guess when confidence is low. This is a design principle across every engagement, not just how the support bot itself behaves.

pricing.approach: Cadre AI doesn't publish fixed pricing. Engagements are scoped and quoted based on what you're trying to accomplish, team size, and complexity, so the real number depends on the work. The reliable way to get an actual figure is a scoping call with an AI strategist — that conversation is free and comes with no commitment.

case_studies.summary: Cadre AI publishes real, client-anonymized case studies with quantified results across industries. A few examples:

examples.result: 45 hours saved monthly with an AI lead-processing agent — 1,500+ emails processed and 650+ leads handled monthly across 5 branches.
220 hours saved monthly with AI supplier automation — cut processing time by 60% across 200-300 supplier confirmations processed daily.
8,000+ hours saved annually with AI proposal automation — cut proposal processing time from 1-2 days down to about 20 minutes.
$420,000 saved annually with an AI-powered booking visibility system that eliminated same-day double-booking incidents.
57% increase in daily efficiency with an AI scheduling system — 50% more inspection capacity and a 72% cut in fuel expenses through optimized routing.
3,500 hours saved annually with an AI email agent — reduced email management from about 9 hours a week to roughly 55 minutes.
2,500 hours saved annually with a Loan Intelligence Assistant used daily by 27 loan officers, handling 3,960+ chat inquiries in its first 90 days.

case_studies.note: Full write-ups, including named client quotes where shared, are public on the Cadre AI website's Case Studies page.
